sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B-NVFP4 huggingface.co is an AI model on huggingface.co that provides Qwen3.5-9B-NVFP4's model effect (), which can be used instantly with this AxionML Qwen3.5-9B-NVFP4 model. huggingface.co supports a free trial of the Qwen3.5-9B-NVFP4 model, and also provides paid use of the Qwen3.5-9B-NVFP4. Support call Qwen3.5-9B-NVFP4 model through api, including Node.js, Python, http.

sources.title: Qwen3.5 9B NVFP4 by Qwen (Alibaba) — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A compact multimodal model that punches with efficiency — the NVFP4 quantization means it runs leaner on compatible hardware without dramatic quality loss. It handles both text and image inputs, making it versatile for vision-language tasks. The trade-off is that quantized weights can introduce subtle degradation on nuanced reasoning compared to full-precision counterparts.
